company.name: Garner Health
company.shortDescription: Garner Health is a healthcare technology company that connects employers and employees with high-performing medical providers.
company.description: Garner Health is a healthcare technology company that provides a platform designed to help employers and employees access high-performing medical providers. It analyzes clinical performance data and claims information to identify physicians based on quality and outcomes metrics. The company partners with employers to offer benefit programs that include financial incentives for employees who select providers through its platform. It also supports navigation services that assist members in finding and scheduling care. Its model combines data analytics, provider evaluation, and benefits integration to support informed healthcare decisions.
